name: Acute Pericarditis

any_of: diffuse st elevation with pr depression
widespread st elevation and pr depression

diagnostic_limitations: Support for a differential diagnosis, not a standalone diagnostic criterion. Missing or normal results do not exclude disease.

name: Acute Heart Failure
diagnostic_limitations: Preserved ejection fraction does not exclude heart failure; evaluate cardiac function and congestion together.

name: Pleural Effusion
diagnostic_limitations: Describes pleural fluid, not its cause; infection, malignancy, embolism and heart failure require further evaluation.

name: Acute Cholecystitis
diagnostic_limitations: Support for a differential diagnosis, not a standalone diagnostic criterion. Missing or normal results do not exclude disease.

name: Acute Cholangitis
diagnostic_limitations: Support for a differential diagnosis, not a standalone diagnostic criterion. Missing or normal results do not exclude disease.

name: Acute Diverticulitis
diagnostic_limitations: Support for a differential diagnosis, not a standalone diagnostic criterion. Missing or normal results do not exclude disease.

name: Small Bowel Obstruction

any_of: transition point with collapsed distal bowel

diagnostic_limitations: Support for a differential diagnosis, not a standalone diagnostic criterion. Missing or normal results do not exclude disease.

name: Acute Mesenteric Ischemia
typical_features: pain out of proportion to examination
diagnostic_limitations: Support for a differential diagnosis, not a standalone diagnostic criterion. Missing or normal results do not exclude disease.

name: Ovarian Torsion
diagnostic_limitations: Normal Doppler flow does not exclude torsion; surgical assessment is required when suspected.

name: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease
diagnostic_limitations: Clinical diagnosis; the conservative support rules do not mean both findings are required to consider or treat PID.

name: Hemorrhagic Ovarian Cyst

any_of: lacy internal echoes in ovarian cyst

diagnostic_limitations: Exclude ectopic pregnancy and torsion; instability or hemoperitoneum requires urgent assessment.

name: Intracerebral Hemorrhage
diagnostic_limitations: Support for a differential diagnosis, not a standalone diagnostic criterion. Missing or normal results do not exclude disease.

name: Epidural Hematoma

name: Brain Abscess
diagnostic_limitations: Imaging pattern supports but does not prove infection; distinguish tumor and other lesions, with specialist assessment.

name: Subdural Empyema
diagnostic_limitations: Support for a differential diagnosis, not a standalone diagnostic criterion. Missing or normal results do not exclude disease.

name: Lung Abscess
diagnostic_limitations: Cavitation also occurs in malignancy and tuberculosis; microbiological and clinical assessment remain necessary.

name: Renal Infarction
diagnostic_limitations: Support for a differential diagnosis, not a standalone diagnostic criterion. Missing or normal results do not exclude disease.

name: Obstructive Uropathy
diagnostic_limitations: Hydronephrosis alone does not establish obstruction; determine cause and assess infection and renal function.

name: Acute Urinary Retention
diagnostic_limitations: Support for a differential diagnosis, not a standalone diagnostic criterion. Missing or normal results do not exclude disease.

name: Acute Kidney Injury

any_of: acute rise in creatinine from baseline

diagnostic_limitations: Requires timing and baseline; isolated elevated creatinine cannot distinguish acute from chronic kidney disease.

name: Hyperosmolar Hyperglycemic State
diagnostic_limitations: Assess acid-base status and overlapping DKA. Qualitative laboratory interpretation required; thresholds are not inferred from unparsed numbers.

name: Iron Deficiency Anemia
diagnostic_limitations: Evaluate bleeding and other causes; ferritin can be increased by inflammation.

name: Primary Hypothyroidism
diagnostic_limitations: This entry covers primary hypothyroidism, not central disease; severe decompensation requires urgent assessment.

name: Hyperthyroidism
diagnostic_limitations: Support for a differential diagnosis, not a standalone diagnostic criterion. Missing or normal results do not exclude disease.

name: Deep Vein Thrombosis
diagnostic_limitations: Assess concurrent PE for chest symptoms; negative limited ultrasound does not always exclude distal or early thrombosis.

name: Cellulitis

any_of: warmth and tenderness of erythematous skin

diagnostic_limitations: Consider DVT and dermatitis; disproportionate pain or systemic instability requires assessment for necrotizing infection.

name: Herpes Zoster

any_of: vesicular rash confined to one dermatome

diagnostic_limitations: Eye or ear involvement and immunocompromise require additional urgent assessment.

name: Septic Arthritis
diagnostic_limitations: Negative Gram stain or concurrent crystals do not exclude septic arthritis.

name: Acute Gout
diagnostic_limitations: Crystals do not exclude concurrent septic arthritis; serum urate alone is not diagnostic.

name: Acute Hepatitis
diagnostic_limitations: This is a syndrome-level differential; viral, toxic, ischemic and autoimmune causes need separate investigation.

name: Rhabdomyolysis

any_of: creatine kinase greater than five times upper limit
heme positive with few red cells

diagnostic_limitations: Support for a differential diagnosis, not a standalone diagnostic criterion. Missing or normal results do not exclude disease.

name: Carbon Monoxide Poisoning
diagnostic_limitations: Normal pulse oximetry does not exclude CO poisoning; interpret COHb in exposure and oxygen-treatment context.

name: Influenza
diagnostic_limitations: Negative testing does not always exclude infection; assess complications and high-risk patients.
